query: How do I make white chocolate-dipped pretzels?

goal.title: Make white-coated star pretzels
goal.description: Portion star-shaped pretzels, melt white baking chips in a small saucepan, coat individual pretzels, and move them onto a lined tray and briefly into the freezer.
goal.final_state: Five white-coated pretzels are displayed on the lined round tray after it is taken back out of the freezer.
procedure: Open the pretzel bag, pour pretzels onto a plate, and arrange them.
Add white baking chips to the saucepan and stir over the stove until softened.
Use the spatula and fork to coat individual pretzels and transfer them onto the lined tray.
Repeat the coating and transfer until five pieces are on the tray.
Carry the tray to the freezer, close it, then reopen and retrieve the tray.

phases.description: The bag is opened and pretzels poured onto a plate, then spread into a manageable layer.
White chips are added to the small saucepan and stirred with a silicone spatula while the other hand steadies the handle through a mitt.
A fork and spatula turn the pretzels through the white mixture; a coated piece is moved onto the lined tray and another is started.
The coating is stirred, another star is added, coated with the two utensils, and transferred to the tray.
Further pretzels are added and repeatedly turned through the mixture; the utensils scrape coating over them before transfer to the tray.
The tray is carried to the freezer and placed inside; the door is closed, then immediately reopened and the tray removed for display.
